goal: Independently reconcile real observed private model context savings while preventing unwarranted cache/latency speedup and deployment claims

independent_reconciliation.context_selector: synthetic fixed tag selector, not canonical registry
independent_reconciliation.cache_or_cold_start_confounding: likely but unproven; large first full latency, later full trials unusually fast

defect_prevention: Independent arithmetic recomputation from per-case metrics rejects aggregate-only token savings claims
Missing usage, tampered digests, contradictory case count/latency, and false training/production claims rejected
Accuracy regression cannot be hidden by token compression
Possible cold-start/prompt-cache confounding reported separately from input-token savings
Source/runner authenticity still requires host and artifact verification outside pure parser

decision.why: 4-case fixed-source pilot cannot demonstrate broad task accuracy or actual canonical router performance

next_ranked.task: Run real canonical registry source selector on authorized project tasks
next_ranked.acceptance: exact ArtifactRefs, zero unauthorized reads, source coverage, answer quality and input token comparison

next_ranked.task: Control prefix-cache and cold-start timing confounds
next_ranked.acceptance: randomized per-condition restart/cache reset, p50/p95 wall time and peak RAM across 10+ tasks

next_ranked.task: Independent reviewer performs release and license checks for draft PRs #205/#121
next_ranked.acceptance: bounded production rollout, restart and rollback passes

lenses.n_ality: quality, token count, wall latency, provenance and authority remain distinct
lenses.continuum: resource behavior must be measured across lengths, cache states and tasks
lenses.fuzzy: not used for binary quality/security gates
